notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Five Hundred Year Diary and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Five Hundred Year Diary and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
